diagnosis.overview: The agent consistently fails to accurately retrieve and extract precise data from source documents (PDFs, spreadsheets), leading to pervasive hallucinations, generic placeholders, miscalculations, and omitted deliverables.
diagnosis.root_cause: The agent consistently fails to accurately retrieve and extract precise data from source documents (PDFs, spreadsheets), leading to pervasive hallucinations, generic placeholders, miscalculations, and omitted deliverables.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: 1) Bind a powerful document extraction tool (capable of parsing PDFs and Excel files, returning structured tables, named entities, and exact cell values) to the agent's toolkit. 2) Add a prompt rule that requires the agent to cite exact source values (with file/sheet references) before computing or stating any metric, and to flag missing data instead of substituting approximations.
